description: Extracts structured album discographies, ranked lists, and similar content from Radio Times articles.

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - get_album_list: 从Radio Times文章提取专辑列表、排行榜等内容; 需要url参数; 参数: url; 必填: url
  - get_page_info: 获取页面基本信息和结构概览; 需要url参数; 参数: url; 必填: url

url.description: Radio Times文章的完整URL (例如 https://www.radiotimes.com/audio/...)
